title: Bibim Guksu (Korean Cold Noodle Salad)
ldKeywords: bibim guksu, korean noodle salad, spicy korean noodle salad
ldIngredientsRaw: 180 g dried buckwheat noodles ((or soba noodles)(6.3 ounces))
2  lettuce leaves ((40g / 1.5 ounces), e.g. butter or oakleaf lettuce, thinly sliced)
A few  snow pea sprouts (, optional)
2 Tbsp kimchi (, cut into thumbnail size)
ldInstructionsRaw: Boil the noodles in rolling boiling water following the package instructions. (I boiled mine for 3 mins.) Drain the noodles and run some cold water over the noodles to cool them down. Drain.
Place the noodles in a large serving bowl and add the salad ingredients and sauce. Serve.
To eat, mix all ingredients well with chopsticks and indulge.
